challenge_test: init readiness: a truly empty folder gets a real scaffold check that fails when code is added

control_test: init readiness: VERSION alone is backfilled and verified
challenge_test: init readiness: failing existing checks block success and are preserved

control_test: init readiness: existing remote content is connected before scaffolding
challenge_test: init readiness: unreadable origin cannot be swallowed as a successful connection

challenge_test: gate: NO origin (origin_required default) refuses as ambiguous

control_test: release_gate: local-tests passes when the test command succeeds

challenge_test: guard: on a feature branch returns 1 with branch names and git remediation
